options.content: Use this dashboard from left to right. First check **coverage**: low coverage means calls are arriving but not producing transcript text. Then check **STT runtime**: high in-progress workers, high p95 latency, lock timeouts, exceptions, or empty outputs point to faster-whisper backlog/model contention rather than bad radio audio. Finally check **mangled proxies**: low text density, very short text, and repeated short phrases are not proof of bad transcription, but they mark calls that deserve review. The raw log panel at the bottom shows the exact Whisper timeout/error lines behind the metrics.
